scope: all fifteen remaining purchasable lines, identical models and quantities

lines.model: Raspberry Pi SC1224 Camera Module 3 Wide, visible-light IR-filter IMX708
lines.notes: Required for camera-guided pickup. SC1224 is the Wide visible-light/IR-filter version. Existing SC1892 and mount geometry describe the Zero-form-factor baseline only; confirm the selected Pi camera interface and cable before connecting.

lines.model: Raspberry Pi SC1892 200mm camera FFC, 15-pin to 22-pin
lines.notes: Retain the existing 200 mm SC1892 15-to-22 cable. Use only after confirming the exact borrowed Pi connector; this is not a universal Pi 3/Zero cable requirement. Preserve a service loop through head motion; no soldering.
Board 25.6x22.7x4.6mm; reserved envelope 28x25x8mm. A moving head mount cannot substitute for a trunk measurement.

lines.model: Adafruit 4397 STEMMA QT/Qwiic JST-SH4 to female sockets, 150mm
lines.notes: Pi physical pins 1=3.3V, 9=GND, 3=SDA, 5=SCL. Physical pin 6 is now one of the two Pi power returns; do not double-occupy it. Validate actual I2C timing. Extend the selected 150mm cable to 250mm: retain approximately 100mm at the JST-SH end, remove its original Pi sockets, and splice four club-sourced approximately 150mm precrimp female tails, individually insulated. Measure finished length and motion clearance; do not claim the original 150mm cable reaches.
Reserved envelope 22x21x12mm. Included terminal/header require soldering. Do not substitute the newer stereo board.

lines.model: Same Sky CMS-30204-18SP, 8 ohm 1W oval speaker
lines.notes: 30x20x4.2mm maximum body, 8 ohm, 1W. Solder two speaker wires to its pads and clamp their other ends in the amplifier output terminal. Neither speaker output is ground. Gain resistor and software volume limit remain required.
One installed, no purchased spare. Supplemental motor-feeder protection; a current-limited source may not open this fuse.
Nine installed, no purchased spare: eight motor groups covering all fifteen servos and one Pi branch. Nine at the five-piece price tier cost $9.22; ten cost $9.45 before tariff.

lines.model: Adafruit 4472 USB-A to USB-C data/sync cable, 6 inch
lines.notes: USB-A male plugs into SC0727 USB-A female; USB-C male plugs into OpenRB USB-C female. Do not cut either end. OpenRB logic is powered through USB while servo power bypasses the controller high-current path. Validate enumeration and sustained bus communication.
One installed, no purchased spare. Keep the 0.5A fuse before the direct 24AWG audio power pair; insulate all solder joints and provide strain relief.
One fitted 100k resistor from GAIN to VIN for 3dB gain; no purchased spare. Keep the software volume ceiling for the 1W speaker.

lines.model: Adafruit 5991 HUSB238 switchable USB PD receiver
lines.notes: Received in DigiKey order 101587695 (user-confirmed 2026-09-29). Retired from the robot power chain on 2026-10-13, when the ROBOTIS SMPS 12V 5A + SMPS2DXL wall end replaced the 20 V USB-PD chain; kept as an owned spare. Bench use: exactly the 5V DIP switch ON (all switches OFF requests up to 20 V); read 5 V at the terminals before connecting a load. The purchase row is the received r3 order line; no new purchase.

Received in DigiKey order 101587695. 30x26x8mm board in the rear pack, input 6-24V (12 V since 2026-10-13), output 5V +/-1%, efficiency over 90% at 12 V in. Design budget 5A continuous / 7.4A short peak at 5V (3A sustained servo acceptance limit or 5.4A simulated 20 ms servo peaks, plus a 2A non-motor reserve); these are calculation allocations, not measured loads or a physical current limiter. Four power pads require soldering; leave heat-pad cooling space. Budget check: ../redesign-20260913/design-contract.json and verify_design.py.
Received in DigiKey order 101587695 and kept as owned stock. No fuse is fitted anywhere in the robot or the tether.

lines.model: DFRobot FIT0586 XT30 male+female pair / DigiKey 1738-1436-ND
lines.notes: Received in DigiKey order 101587695. One package contains one mating pair. The tether side uses the recessed female contacts; the robot side uses the male contacts. Four solder cups need 18 AWG wires and heat shrink. Mark 12V INPUT; never mate to a 5 V load. Read 11.5-12.5 V at the female before it meets the robot.

shipping_evidence: DigiKey current browser cart: shipping $4.99, tariff $10.28, estimate $129.88, sales tax not shown. Adafruit free continental-US ground threshold is $199; split-order shipping and final taxes have not been quoted.
verdict: Choose the one-store DigiKey basket: it covers the entire remaining purchase set with no verified merchandise-price penalty and one fewer order. This is not a claim of the lowest final landed cost; taxes, tariff and both route shipping fees require current checkout readback.
landed_break_even: Split wins on landed cost only if its reduction in tariff/tax/DigiKey shipping exceeds the extra Adafruit shipping. Merchandise savings are zero.
